# load libraries
library(ggplot2)

```{r}
seed = 1
set.seed(1)
# Load data from southern African database

# set directory
dir = here::here()

# read in and modify data names and assign as date list for c14bazAAR
c14_za <- read_csv(paste0(dir, "/data/SARD_Mar2021_14C.csv")) |>
  rename(c14age = Date, c14std = Uncertainty,  labnr = 'Lab ID',
         lon = DecdegE, lat = DecdegS,
         material = 'Material dated', species = Species) |>
  as.c14_date_list()

```

```{r}
#filter to remove human remains as they produce errors when calibrating
za <- c14_za |>
  filter(species != "Homo sapiens" | is.na(species)) |>
  
  # filter by dates older than 200 years and less than 50 ka
  filter(c14age > 200, c14age < 50000)


# filter by terrestrial material and apply the terrestrial calibration curve
za_terr <- za |>
  filter(!material %in% c('Marine shell', 'marine shell',
                          'marine other', 'iron')) |>
  drop_na(c14age, c14std)

za_terr_cal <- rcarbon::calibrate(za_terr$c14age , za_terr$c14std,
                                      calCurves = 'shcal20',
                                      ids = za_terr$labnr)

# filter by marine material and apply marien curve and offset
za_marine <- za |>
  filter(material %in% c('Marine shell', 'marine shell',
                         'marine other')) |>
  drop_na(c14age, c14std)

za_marine_cal <- rcarbon::calibrate(za_marine$c14age, 
                                    za_marine$c14std,
                                    calCurves = rep('marine20',
                                                    length(za_marine$labnr)),
                                    resOffset = rep(187, length(za_marine$labnr)),
                                    resErrors = rep(18, length(za_marine$labnr)),
                                    ids = za_marine$labnr)

# combine data
za_cal <- rcarbon::combine(za_terr_cal, za_marine_cal)
```

```{r}
# convert dates to a tibble object and join the original table by lab ID
za_comb <- za_cal |> as_tibble() |>
  cbind(za_cal$metadata) |>
  rename(labnr = DateID) |>
  right_join(za)
```

# Hierarchical Modeling

```{r}
sites_sf <- st_as_sf(
  za_comb,
  coords = c("lon", "lat"),
  crs = 4326
)

sites_proj <- st_transform(
  sites_sf,
  32734
)

coords <- st_coordinates(sites_proj)

za_coords <- za_comb |>
  mutate(x = coords[,1],
         y = coords[,2])

study_area <- st_bbox(sites_proj) |>
  st_as_sfc() |>
  st_buffer(dist = 10000) |>
  vect()
```

```{r}
za_holocene <- sites_proj |>
  mutate(x = st_coordinates(sites_proj)[,1],
         y = st_coordinates(sites_proj)[,2]) |>
  filter(c14age < 21000) 

za_holocene |>
  group_by(`Province or district`) |>
  summarize(count = n())
  
ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data = za_holocene, aes(color = `Province or district`))
```

```{r}

nn <- frNN(za_holocene |> distinct(Site, .keep_all = TRUE) |> st_coordinates(),
           eps = 110000)

hist(lengths(adjacencylist(nn)),
     xlab = "k", main="Number of Neighbors",
     sub = paste("Neighborhood size eps =", nn$eps))

#i <- 1
#nn$id[[i]]
#nn$dist[[i]]
#plot(za_holocene |> distinct(Site, .keep_all = TRUE) |> st_coordinates(),
     #col = ifelse(seq_len(nrow(za_holocene)) %in% nn$id[[i]], "red", "black"))



clustered_data <- za_holocene |>
  distinct(Site, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(Site) |>
  
  mutate(cluster = {
    
    # Run DBSCAN (adjust eps and minPts to your data's scale)
    res <- dbscan(nn, minPts = 5)
    
    # Return cluster assignments (0 represents noise/outliers)
    res$cluster
  }) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  
  right_join(za_holocene, by = "Site") |>
  st_sf()

clustered_data |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  mutate(n_cluster = n()) |>
  filter(n_cluster < 15) |>
  group_by(Site, cluster, n_cluster) |>
  summarize(n_site = n()) |>
  mutate(Site_ex = ifelse((n_cluster == n_site) | (n_site < 10), 1, 0)) |>
  filter(Site_ex == 1) -> site_exc

#  Remove the noise cluster and clusters with too few site-specific observations
clustered_data <- clustered_data |>
  filter(!(cluster %in% c(0, site_exc$cluster)))
  
# Explore clustered data
ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data = clustered_data, aes(color = factor(cluster)))
```

```{r}
# filter by late pleistocene
max_age <- 12000 
min_age <- 1500
temp_res <- 500

# generate temporal grids
time_grid <- seq(
  from = max_age,
  to = min_age,
  by = -(temp_res)
)


clustered_data$calBP <- unlist(
  
  lapply(
    
    1:length(clustered_data$grids),
    
    function(x) {
      
      val <- clustered_data$grids[[x]]$PrDens
      if (length(val) == 0) return(NA)
      
      clustered_data$grids[[x]]$calBP[which.max(clustered_data$grids[[x]]$PrDens)]
      
    }
    
  )
)
```

```{r}
fit_df <- clustered_data |>
  
  filter(
    calBP >= min_age,
    calBP <= max_age
  ) |>
  mutate(
    time_bin = round(calBP / temp_res) * temp_res
  ) |>
  count(
    cluster,
    time_bin,
    name = "n_dates"
  ) |>
  
  mutate(time_s = as.numeric(scale(time_bin)),
       cluster_fct = factor(cluster),
       cluster_num = as.numeric(cluster))
```

## Bayesian Modeling

```{r}
# Time
seed <- seed + 1
fit_time <- brm(
  n_dates ~
    1 + time_s,
  
  family = poisson(),
  
  data = fit_df,
  
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b")
  ),
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = 0.95
  ),
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(4),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed
)

# Space
seed <- seed + 1
fit_space_fct <- brm(
  n_dates ~
    1 + cluster_fct,
  
  family = poisson(),
  
  data = fit_df,
  
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b")
  ),
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = 0.95
  ),
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(4),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed
)

# Space
seed <- seed + 1
fit_space_h <- brm(
  n_dates ~
    1 + (1|cluster_fct),
  
  family = poisson(),
  
  data = fit_df,
  
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = "Intercept")
  ),
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = 0.95
  ),
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(4),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed
)

# Space + Time
seed <- seed + 1
fit_space_time <- brm(
  n_dates ~
    1 + time_s + (1|cluster_fct),
  
  family = poisson(),
  
  data = fit_df,
  
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = "Intercept")
  ),
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = 0.95
  ),
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(4),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed
)


# Varying slope and intercept
seed <- seed + 1
fit_space_time <- brm(
  n_dates ~
    1 + time_s + (time_s|cluster_fct),
  
  family = poisson(),
  
  data = fit_df,
  
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = "Intercept")
  ),
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = 0.95
  ),
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(4),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed
)
```

```{r}
cluster_draws <- fit_space_h |>
  spread_draws(
    r_cluster_fct[cluster_fct, term],
    regex = TRUE
  )

cluster_draws <- as_draws_df(fit_space_h)

cluster_summary <- fit_space_h |>
  spread_draws(
    r_cluster_fct[cluster, term]
  ) |>
  filter(term == "Intercept") |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  summarise(
    mean = exp(mean(r_cluster_fct)),
    median = exp(median(r_cluster_fct)),
    lower = exp(quantile(r_cluster_fct, 0.025)),
    upper = exp(quantile(r_cluster_fct, 0.975)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cluster_summary |>
  filter((lower > 1 & upper > 1) | (lower < 1 & upper < 1))

ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data = clustered_data |> filter(cluster %in% c("1", "4")), 
          aes(color = factor(cluster)), size = 3) +
  
  geom_sf(data = clustered_data |> filter(cluster %in% c("8")), 
          aes(color = factor(cluster)), size = 3)
```

```{r}
region_slopes <- fit_space_time |>
  spread_draws(
    b_time_s,
    r_cluster_fct[cluster, term]
  ) |>
  filter(term == "time_s") |>
  mutate(
    slope = b_time_s + r_cluster_fct
  ) |>
  as_tibble()

region_slopes <- region_slopes |>
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(cluster)
  )


region_summary <- region_slopes |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  summarise(
    median_slope = median(slope),
    lower_95 = quantile(slope, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(slope, 0.975),
    prob_negative = mean(slope < 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )




ggplot(region_slopes) +
  geom_density_ridges(aes(
    x = slope,
    y = cluster
  )) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  theme_ridges() +
  labs(
    x = "Regional temporal slope",
    y = "Cluster"
  )


ggplot(
  region_summary,
  aes(
    x = median_slope,
    y = reorder(cluster, median_slope)
  )
) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = lower_95,
      xmax = upper_95
    ),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Temporal slope",
    y = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
col_clus <- region_summary |>
  mutate(col = ifelse((region_summary$lower_95 < 0 & region_summary$upper_95 <0) |
                  (region_summary$lower_95 > 0 & region_summary$upper_95 > 0),
                "Negative", "Zero"))
  
ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data = clustered_data |>
            right_join(col_clus |> 
            select(cluster, col) |>

          aes(color = factor(col)))
```

## Compare slope rates between clusters

```{r}
clusters <- sort(unique(region_slopes$cluster))

pairwise_slopes <- combn(
  clusters,
  2,
  simplify = FALSE
)

results <- lapply(
  pairwise_slopes,
  function(pair) {
    
    tmp <- region_slopes |>
      filter(cluster %in% pair) |>
      select(.draw, cluster, slope) |>
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = cluster,
        values_from = slope
      )
    
    difference <- tmp[[as.character(pair[1])]] -
      tmp[[as.character(pair[2])]]
    
    tibble(
      cluster_1 = pair[1],
      cluster_2 = pair[2],
      median_difference = median(difference),
      lower_95 = quantile(difference, 0.025),
      upper_95 = quantile(difference, 0.975),
      `P(Difference > 0)` = mean(difference > 0)
    )
  }
) |>
  bind_rows()

results |>
  filter((lower_95 < 0 & upper_95 < 0) | (lower_95 > 0 & upper_95 > 0)) |>
  select(cluster_1, cluster_2, median_difference, `P(Difference > 0)`)
```

```{r}
cluster_polygons <- clustered_data |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  summarise(geometry = st_convex_hull(st_combine(geometry))) |>
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster))
  
  clustered_points <- clustered_data |>
    full_join(results |>
                 filter(cluster_1 == 1) |>
                 mutate(cluster_2 = as.numeric(cluster_2)) |>
                 rename(cluster = cluster_2))
  
  ggplot()+
    geom_sf(data = cluster_polygons, aes(fill = cluster), alpha = 0.25)+
    geom_sf(data = clustered_points, aes(col = median_difference))+
    theme_void()
```

# Discrete Periods

```{r}
time_intervals <- c(max_age, 18000, 12000,
                    12000, 8000, 7000, 4000, 2000, min_age)

time_mean <- attr(
  scale(fit_df$time_bin),
  "scaled:center"
)

time_sd <- attr(
  scale(fit_df$time_bin),
  "scaled:scale"
)



prediction_data <- expand.grid(
  cluster_fct = levels(fit_df$cluster_fct),
  calBP = time_intervals
)  |>
  mutate(
    time_s = (calBP - time_mean) / time_sd
  )


prediction_draws <- fit_space_time |>
  epred_draws(
    newdata = prediction_data,
    re_formula = NULL
  ) |>
  rename(cluster = cluster_fct) |>
  mutate(cluster = as.factor(cluster),
         calBP = as.factor(calBP)) |>
  as_tibble()


interval_summary <- prediction_draws |>
  group_by(cluster, calBP) |>
  summarise(
    median = median(.epred),
    lower = quantile(.epred, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(.epred, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
comparison <- prediction_draws |>
  distinct(calBP, .draw, cluster, .epred, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  group_by(calBP) |>
  select(.draw, cluster, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = cluster,
    values_from = .epred,
    names_prefix = "cluster_"
  ) |>
  mutate(calBP = as.numeric(as.character(calBP)))
  

```

# Intensity Modeling

```{r}
# filter by late pleistocene
max_age <- 10000 
min_age <- 1500
temp_res <- 500
  
za_21ka <- za_comb |>
  filter(c14age < max_age, lat != max(lat))

# generate temporal grids
time_grid <- seq(
  from = max_age,
  to = min_age,
  by = -(temp_res)
)


za_21ka$calBP <- unlist(
  
  lapply(
  
    1:length(za_21ka$grids),
  
    function(x) {
      
      val <- za_21ka$grids[[x]]$PrDens
      if (length(val) == 0) return(NA)
    
      za_21ka$grids[[x]]$calBP[which.max(za_21ka$grids[[x]]$PrDens)]
    
    }
  
  )
)

```

```{r}
sites_sf <- st_as_sf(
  za_21ka,
  coords = c("lon", "lat"),
  crs = 4326
)

sites_proj <- st_transform(
  sites_sf,
  32734
)
 
coords <- st_coordinates(sites_proj)

za_21ka$x <- coords[,1]
za_21ka$y <- coords[,2]

study_area <- st_bbox(sites_proj) |>
  st_as_sfc() |>
  st_buffer(dist = 10000) |>
  vect()

r <- rast(
  ext(study_area),
  resolution = 100000,
  crs = st_crs(sites_proj)$wkt
)

values(r) <- 1 # Gives every cell a value

r <- mask(
  r,
  study_area
)
```

```{r}
grid <- as.data.frame(
  r,
  xy = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

names(grid) <- c(
  "x",
  "y",
  "cell"
)

grid$cell <- seq_len(nrow(grid))

c14_sf <- st_as_sf(
  za_21ka,
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = st_crs(sites_proj)
)

grid_sf <- st_as_sf(
  grid,
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = st_crs(sites_proj)
)

cell_id <- st_nearest_feature(
  c14_sf,
  grid_sf
)

za_21ka$cell <- cell_id
```

```{r}
model_grid <- expand_grid(
  cell = 1:nrow(grid),
  time = time_grid
)

model_grid <- model_grid |>
  left_join(
    grid |>
      mutate(cell = row_number()),
    by = "cell"
  )
```

```{r}
observations <- za_21ka |>
  filter(
    calBP >= min_age,
    calBP <= max_age
  ) |>
  mutate(
    time_bin = round(calBP / temp_res) * temp_res
  ) |>
  count(
    cell,
    time_bin,
    name = "n_dates"
  )



model_grid <- model_grid |>
  left_join(
    observations,
    by = c(
      "cell",
      "time" = "time_bin"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    n_dates = replace_na(n_dates, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
# Run first Bayesian model to estimate lambda
fit <- brm(
  n_dates ~
    1 +
    factor(cell) +
    factor(time),
  
  family = poisson(),
  
  data = model_grid,
  
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b")
  ),
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = 0.95
  ),
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(4),
  backend = 'cmdstanr'
)
```

```{r}
# scale data
model_grid_scaled <- model_grid |>
  mutate(x_scale = as.numeric(scale(x)),
         y_scale = as.numeric(scale(y)),
         time_scale = as.numeric(scale(time)))

temporal_data <- model_grid_scaled |>
  group_by(time) |>
  summarise(
    n_dates = sum(n_dates),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    time_scale = as.numeric(scale(time))
  )


fit_time <- brm(
  n_dates ~
    1 + time_scale,
  
  family = poisson(),
  
  data = temporal_data,
  
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b")
  ),
  
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = 0.95,
    max_treedepth = 10
  ),
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(4),
  
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)
```

```{r}
spatial_data <- model_grid_scaled |>
  group_by(cell, x_scale, y_scale) |>
  summarise(
    n_dates = sum(n_dates),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fit_space <- brm(
  n_dates ~
    1 + gp(x_scale, y_scale, k = 5),
  
  family = poisson(),
  
  data = spatial_data,
  
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = "Intercept")
  ),
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = 0.95,
    max_treedepth = 10
  ),
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(4),
  
  backend = "cmdstanr"
)
```
